prompt: Create one true TOP orthographic plan of the exact Iron Trains passenger bench from the first reference. Use the second reference only for a top-down bench shape guide: narrow seat depth, long bench axis, three seat regions, and thin backrest edge. Preserve the target's dark iron end rails and worn reddish-brown wood (no red upholstery, no yellow trim). Directly overhead camera, not a front/elevated view. Show the seating surface as a shallow rectangle with three horizontal plank sections; put the three broad upright backrest boards edge-on as a narrow strip along only one long edge. Iron arm/leg structures appear as thin side footprints at the two ends. Never show the broad face of the backrest, a tall wall, or a side profile. Match source support count and spacing. Transparent background, centered full shape on a 256x256 canvas. Inferred orthographic view; not recovered pixels or calibrated 3D.

independently approved same-object top-down shape guide only; do not copy its material/style
